intro.cn: 在家门口，刘明开门进到家里。
intro.en: At the doorway, Liu Ming opened the door and went into the house.

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.cn: 工作太多了，下班的时候没做完。
lines.en: I had too much work to do, and I hadn't finished it when it was time to get off work.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 菜都做好了，过来吃饭吧。

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.en: I'd like to take a break and have a glass of water first.

postQuestions.q: 今天刘明的工作多不多？
王一雪已经做好什么了？

title.en: Planning a trip in the living room

intro.cn: 在客厅，刘明和王一雪在聊天儿。
intro.en: In the living room, Liu Ming and Wang Yixue were chatting.

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.cn: 我们找个时间去旅游，怎么样？
lines.en: Why don't we find some time to go on a trip?

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 好啊，我也很想一起出去玩。
lines.en: Great! I also really want to go traveling with you.

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.en: Where do you want to go?

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.en: I haven't figured it out yet.

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.cn: 那你再想一想，你想好了，我来买票。
lines.en: Then think about it further. Once you've made up your mind, I'll buy the tickets.

postQuestions.q: 王一雪想好去哪儿了吗？

title.en: Eating apples in the living room

intro.cn: 在客厅，刘明和王一雪在聊天儿。
intro.en: In the living room, Liu Ming and Wang Yixue were chatting.

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.cn: 吃个苹果吧，我都洗好了。
lines.en: Have an apple. I've already washed them.

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.en: They're on the table. Help yourself.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 我去洗洗手。对了，我们去西安旅游，怎么样？
lines.en: I'm going to wash my hands first. By the way, how about taking a trip to Xi'an?

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.en: Why do you want to go to Xi'an?

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 我看了看网上的介绍，这个时候去西安很不错！
lines.en: I read some introductions online—it's a great time to visit Xi'an!

postQuestions.q: 王一雪为什么想去西安旅游？

intro.cn: 在家里，王一雪给好朋友打电话。
intro.en: At home, Wang Yixue was calling her best friend.

questions.q: 判断正误：刘明今天没去医院上班。
判断正误：今天早上是刘明送孩子去学校的。

lines.cn: 早上，刘明开车送孩子去学校，送完孩子回家后，医院就来电话了，让他回去上班。
lines.en: In the morning, Liu Ming drove the child to school. But just after he got home, the hospital called—they asked him to go back to work.

lines.cn: 我觉得他这个月每天都很累，真想让他休息休息。
lines.en: I think he's been very tired every day this month. I really wish he could get some rest.

grammar.note: 一些动词或者形容词用在动词后面，表示动作的结果。否定形式是在动词前面加“没（有）”，同时要去掉“了”。疑问形式有三种：句尾加“了吗”；句尾加“（了）没有”；动词+没+动词+结果补语。
grammar.noteEn: Some verbs or adjectives can be placed after a verb to indicate the result of the action. The negative form is formed by adding “没（有）” before the verb and removing “了”. There are three interrogative forms: add “了吗” at the end; add “（了）没有” at the end; or Verb + 没 + Verb + Complement of Result.

items.en: Have you learned it or not?

practice.cn: A：小明，你____衣服没有？ B：我穿好了。
A：老师，我写完了。 B：很好，这几个字都____了。
A：这本书你____？ B：没看懂，我有很多问题。

grammar.note: 动作性比较强、能重复或持续的动词重叠使用，表示时间短、数量少、尝试等意思，语气比较轻松、随意，多用于口语。单音节动词的重叠形式是“A（一）A”，双音节动词的重叠形式是“ABAB”，离合词的重叠形式是“AAB”。
grammar.noteEn: Action verbs that are dynamic, repeatable or continuous may appear in a reduplicated form. Such reduplication usually indicates brief actions, limited repetitions, or simple attempts. It conveys a relaxed and casual tone and is mostly used in spoken Chinese. The reduplicated form of a monosyllabic verb is “A（一）A”; that of a disyllabic verb is “ABAB”; and that of a separable word is “AAB”.

items.c: 那你再想一想，你想好了，我来买票。
items.en: Then think about it further. Once you've made up your mind, I'll buy the tickets.

items.c: 我有点儿累，现在想休息休息。
items.en: I'm a bit tired and want to rest for a while.
Could you come over and help?

practice.cn: A：家月，学校里有没有超市？ B：我也不知道，你去____老师吧。
A：那个人是谁？ B：你不认识？那我给你____。
A：他的歌真好听！ B：是吗？让我____。

grammar.note: 表达已经发生的情况时，单音节动词的重叠形式是“A了A”；双音节动词一般不能用重叠形式，只能用“AB了一下”；离合词的重叠形式是“A了AB”。
grammar.noteEn: When describing an action that has already taken place, the reduplicated form of a monosyllabic verb is “A了A”. Generally, a disyllabic verb cannot be used in its reduplicated form; instead, “AB了一下” is used. The reduplicated form of a separable word is “A了AB”.

items.en: I took a look at the introductions online.

items.c: 我休息了一下，现在觉得不累了。
items.en: I rested for a while, and now I don't feel tired.

practice.cn: A：昨天你在家吗？ B：我有点儿事，____了一下。
A：你的手机是不是在桌子上？ B：我在桌子上____，但没有。
A：昨天下午你做什么了？ B：我在房间____书，____字。

tips.note: “对了”表示突然想起另外一件事或提出另一个话题。
tips.noteEn: “对了” is used when you suddenly remember something else or bring up another topic.

classroomActivity.description: 两人一组，互相询问：想不想去旅游？想好去哪儿旅游了吗？为什么选择该旅游地？等等。尽可能使用本课所学生词和语法。
classroomActivity.descriptionEn: Work in pairs. Ask each other: Do you want to travel? Have you decided on a destination? Why did you choose this place? etc. Try to use the vocabulary and grammar learned in this lesson as much as possible.
